name: Cobble the Street Tabby
blurb: Cobble, a lean brown-grey mackerel tabby with a nicked ear and green-gold eyes, came in off the back lanes and walks the wall at dusk.

name: Dapple the Spotted Cat
blurb: Dapple, a tawny house cat with dark spots, a cream belly and black-tipped ears, creeps through the long grass and pounces on leaves.

name: Shortcut the Golden Cat
blurb: Shortcut, a solid golden-tawny cat with copper eyes, knows every gap in the hedges and leads visitors the quickest way to the pond.
